source: ERA5-Land monthly averaged reanalysis, volumetric soil water layers 1-3, Copernicus Climate Change Service (C3S) Climate Data Store; contains modified Copernicus Climate Change Service information

fields.normal: mean soil moisture per calendar month 2001-2020, m3/m3
fields.z10: anomaly vs that normal, z-score x 10 (so -15 = 1.5 standard deviations drier)
